julia (auditor): Hi team, need a compact evidence package: RBAC edit on infra/restore-reader and KMS decrypts during a triage window. Window: 2026-04-10T17:05:00Z -> 2026-04-10T17:35:00Z. We need RBAC delta, KMS Decrypt events, and any S3 GetObject that used those decrypts.

henry: Copy. Which service account and binding name?

julia (auditor): ServiceAccount infra/restore-reader, RoleBinding: infra-restore-binding, edit recorded ~17:18.

noor: Plan: slice kube-apiserver audit for RoleBinding updates, dump IRSA annotation mapping, CloudTrail decrypts filtered by key aliases alias/redwood-* in window, and S3 access rows with matching requestIds. We'll produce an evidence zip and an exhibit_map.txt.

henry: Commands I'll run: kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.name=infra-restore-binding -o json | jq '.' > k8s_rbac_slice.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-04-10T17:05:00Z --end-time 2026-04-10T17:35:00Z > cloudtrail_decrypts.json
aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/04/10/17/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-04-10T17:05:00Z' AND '2026-04-10T17:35:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

noor: Cross-correlation tip: match requestParameters.ciphertextBlob/keyId in Decrypt events to S3 GETs' x-amz-request-id or our app request_id in logs. Also check STS assume-role/session for long-lived sessions.

julia (auditor): Need an audit-friendly manifest listing files and a 1-line rationale per decrypt saying related/unrelated.

henry: We'll include: manifest.txt, k8s_rbac_slice.json, irsa_map.txt, cloudtrail_decrypts.json, s3_reads.json, exhibit_map.txt, redaction_log.txt, extract_cmds.sh.

ops-bot: Starting export: evidence_6250001111_20260410, staging to s3://redwood-compliance-temp/. Presigned link will be valid 7 days.

noor: Quick note: I see three Decrypt events in the slice, timestamps 17:12, 17:16, 17:22. First two predate the RBAC edit, third is post-edit. We'll validate session ARNs for the 17:22 event.

julia (auditor): If the 17:22 decrypt is from an assumed role with session created before 17:18, mark as unrelated; otherwise mark "further analysis" and escalate.

ops-bot: Export complete: s3://redwood-compliance-temp/evidence_6250001111_20260410.zip (presigned: https://presigned.example/evidence/6250001111). SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924.

henry: Bundle uploaded, exhibit_map.txt will annotate the 17:22 event with session ARN and request id. Reply here when you download.

julia (auditor): Downloading now. Thanks all — will follow up if we need deeper forensics.
